full_page.content:
Page 128 Cont.
Feb. 28 Thanks - Mary Wiethoff - 33 - 12 years off and on with very peculiar ache in salivary gland in front of left ear. Enrolled specially for this last Friday. Thing looked and from out side felt like blind cancer. Was advised to promise some little sacrifice if relief came inside of week. In side an hour she phoned " a bone-like piece of calsium " was in her own little pincers, which she easily succeeded in extracting from inside of her jaw. Looks ten yrs. young. To-day ... Febr. 8th, 1948 Same Mary Wiethoff writes " ... No more troubles with said jaw .... " Sends perpetual enrollment for Poor Souls in thanks- giving. $5.00
Page 129
Feb. 29 Mr. DeMaire - 91 - cancerous sore on jaw .... Enrolled To-day 5.
29 Geo. Ernsteadt - 43 - heart enlarged for a week in Oxegin tank. 1944, March
March
1 Gert Gerard - elderly lady - severe sinus. ...
The Cruden - parents and two small children - little boy 7 feared fatal.
Mar. 2 Wm. James Zeiger - 13 - a real man in size and character but physi- cally an invalid - unable to stand or even to turn over without help.
Baby Geo Henry Berthiaume - 3 mo. - weak spells since birth.
Theresa Dufour - 18 - Nerve - trouble - has been refusing to eat - now in London, Ont. Hospital - they find she has "strep throat".
James Hayes - 53 - stomach obstruction and ulcer operation expected.
Page 130
Mar. 7th Florenz Sullivan - 39 - had right eye injured when 9 - 30 yrs. back blind ever since; lately the other one started to bother him. When his mother enrolled him, better since - asks prayers ....
Mrs. Emmendorfer - 29 - operation expected next Saturday ... inner organs.
Mrs. Frances Springer - 60 - gall-bl-trouble and a hernia - very stout person fears operation.
Joseph Azar - 59 - in Kiefers with something like spinal maningitis
